title: 第3章 我们打一架吧，像前世那样
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

白色的宿舍楼出现在视线尽头。

门口有一把老旧的躺椅，上面躺着一个老人。

他闭着眼睛，似乎睡着了。花白的头发被风吹得微微晃动，身上穿着一件灰扑扑的袍子，看起来和任何一个晒太阳打盹的普通老人没什么两样。

但王冬儿知道，他是大陆最强的存在。

史莱克学院的守护者，龙神斗罗穆恩。

王冬儿走过去，询问道：“老爷爷，您帮我看看这宿舍是在什么地方？”

穆恩接过王冬儿手中的钥匙。

“108号，一楼左手第三间。”

“谢谢老爷爷。”

穆恩笑着点点头：“又来一个有礼貌的好孩子，好像还是同一个宿舍的。”

王冬儿没有听到穆恩的话，加快速度走进宿舍楼，来到108号房间外。

这扇门和记忆里一模一样，门框上有一道很深的划痕。

王冬儿把钥匙插进锁孔，转动。

咔哒一声，锁开了。

门向内推开。

靠窗的铺位上，坐着一个人。

他低着头，正往床头的小柜子里塞什么东西。

阳光落在他的侧脸上，勾勒出一道清瘦的轮廓，眉骨，鼻梁，微微抿着的嘴唇。

他的头发有点乱，一看就是没有好好打理。身上的衣服是普通的粗布衫，洗得有些发白了，但很干净。

听见门响，他抬起头。

他看到了那双粉蓝色的眼睛，好美。

霍雨浩站起来：“你就是新舍友吧，我叫……”

王冬儿突然扑了过去。

霍雨浩显然没料到舍友一进门就突然扑向自己，他下意识往后退，但身后就是床铺。

王冬儿的双手环住他的肩膀，整个人撞进他怀里，把他直接压倒在床上。

“你！”

王冬儿把脸埋在他的胸口，感受到他身上传来的温度和气息。

不是幻影，不是回忆，不是她灵魂飘在虚空中看着的那个可望不可即的背影。

是活生生的、温热的、还没有被唐舞桐伤害过的霍雨浩。

她抱得很紧，像是要把两辈子的力气都用上。

霍雨浩终于回过神来，手忙脚乱地把她从身上推开，翻身坐起来，整个人贴到了墙壁上。

他的耳朵尖红得像要滴血，脸上写满了惊恐和困惑。

“你谁啊？”

王冬儿被他推开，坐在床铺的另一头，看着他这副样子，忍不住笑了一下。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The white dormitory building appears at the end of the line of sight.

There was an old deck chair at the door, with an old man lying on it.

He closed his eyes and seemed to be asleep.His gray hair was swaying slightly in the wind, and he was wearing a gray robe. He looked like any ordinary old man taking a nap in the sun.

But Wang Donger knew that he was the strongest being on the mainland.

The guardian of Shrek Academy, Dragon God Douluo Munn.

Wang Donger walked over and asked, "Grandpa, can you help me see where this dormitory is?"

Moon took the key from Wang Donger's hand.

"No. 108, the third room on the left on the first floor."

"Thank you, grandpa."

Moon smiled and nodded: "Here comes another polite and good boy. He seems to be from the same dormitory."

Wang Donger didn't hear what Mun En said, so she walked into the dormitory building quickly and came to the outside of Room 108.

The door was exactly as I remembered it, with a deep scratch on the door frame.

Wang Donger inserted the key into the keyhole and turned it.

With a click, the lock opened.

The door opens inwards.

There was a person sitting on the bunk by the window.

He lowered his head and was stuffing something into the small cabinet beside the bed.

The sun fell on the side of his face, outlining a thin outline, brow bones, bridge of nose, and slightly pursed lips.

His hair was a bit messy, and it looked like he hadn't taken good care of it.The clothes he wore were ordinary coarse cloth, a little white from the washing, but very clean.

Hearing the door knock, he raised his head.

He saw those pink-blue eyes, so beautiful.

Huo Yuhao stood up: "You must be the new roommate, my name is..."

Wang Donger suddenly rushed over.

Huo Yuhao obviously didn't expect that his roommate would suddenly pounce on him as soon as he entered the door. He subconsciously stepped back, but behind him was the bed.

Wang Donger's hands wrapped around his shoulders, and she ran into his arms, pressing him directly onto the bed.

"You!"

Wang Donger buried her face in his chest, feeling the warmth and breath coming from his body.

It's not a phantom, it's not a memory, it's not the elusive back figure that her soul is looking at in the void.

It was the living, warm Huo Yuhao who had not been hurt by Tang Wutong.

She hugged her tightly, as if she was going to use her whole life's strength.

Huo Yuhao finally came to his senses, hurriedly pushed her away from him, turned over and sat up, pressing his whole body against the wall.

The tips of his ears were as red as if they were bleeding, and his face was full of fear and confusion.

"Who are you?"

Wang Donger was pushed away by him and sat on the other end of the bed. Looking at his appearance, she couldn't help but smile.
